mechanism: Sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) may increase renal retention of sodium and fluid, and acetaminophen metabolism may be affected in patients with altered renal/hepatic function or fluid retention; additional concern with chronic NSAID-free analgesic use in heart failure patients.
action: Use acetaminophen at lowest effective doses and monitor fluid status; prefer acetaminophen over NSAIDs in sacubitril-treated patients, but maintain awareness of potential hepatotoxicity risk with chronic use.
